heading: EXT. RAILROAD WATER TOWER - HIGH PLAINS - DAWN

units.text: EXT. RAILROAD WATER TOWER - HIGH PLAINS - DAWN
A rusted tower on spindly legs.
Dust devils on the flats.
A single telegraph wire hums in the wind.
MARSHAL EZEKIEL DUNMORE, 50s, hat low, rides in on a gray mare and dismounts at the base.
Waiting there: ODESSA PRATT-ADEYEMI, 30s, canvas duster, rifle across her lap.
Beside her, a boy, LAZARUS, 14, holds a canteen and keeps his eyes on his boots.
Dunmore ties his horse.
Takes his time.
You sent the telegram.
units.name: DUNMORE

units.text: I did.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Said you had the Whitaker brothers.
units.name: DUNMORE

units.text: I did, until they climbed the tower.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: Dunmore looks up.
Two silhouettes against the pale sky, cross-legged on the catwalk.
They armed?
units.name: DUNMORE

units.text: They've got a Winchester and a jug.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: The telegraph wire sings.
Dunmore pulls a pair of spectacles from his pocket, polishes them, puts them on.
Lazarus finally looks up at him.
Marshal. Are you going to shoot them?
units.name: LAZARUS

units.text: Not unless they ask nicely.
units.name: DUNMORE

units.text: Lazarus almost smiles.
Odessa lifts her rifle a hair.
Dunmore, this is Fort Bell. Report.
units.name: RADIO

units.text: Dunmore pulls a small field radio from the saddle.
Raises it to his mouth.
Three at the tower. Two up high. Holding.
units.name: DUNMORE

units.text: Copy. Reinforcements by noon.
units.name: RADIO

units.text: They'll be too late.
units.name: DUNMORE

units.text: He clicks it off.
Takes the rifle from Odessa's lap, hands it back to her, butt first.
Walks to the ladder.
Puts his boot on the first rung.
Marshal.
units.name: ODESSA

units.text: He pauses.
She meets his eyes.
Neither speaks.
Lazarus watches both of them.
Dunmore tips his hat and climbs.
